verdict.rationale: Authenticator documents an Export Passwords flow for autofill passwords (docs-10, docs-14), though the community reports the autofill feature is being discontinued with stored passwords wiped unless users act (comm-11). The only documented backup for authenticator accounts is a cloud backup that restores into Authenticator itself (docs-9, docs-13, docs-19), and a community report says Microsoft's QR codes are not standard TOTP, so other clients reject them (comm-6), which undercuts leaving for another app. Missing for 10: export of OTP/TOTP secrets and account data, documented open export formats (e.g. CSV/otpauth URIs), export of Verified IDs/passkeys, portable non-proprietary backups, and independent corroboration of a complete data exit.
